text: That is exactly what 'Live light' on the Live tab does (wrong live prices judged from the score and clock, not from another book). Press, top to bottom on the Live tab: (1) the master live switch at the top ON; (2) 'Look for tail bets' ON (it must be on for Live light to run); (3) 'Live light: real-time push lane' ON; (4) 'Live light bids' ON for the safe bids: a bid only goes up on a side the score and clock call at least 85% decided, 7% under its fair and under what Novig offers; (5) 'Buy tail bets with real money' ON only if you want real orders (it asks you to confirm; off = paper, it only writes down what it would buy); then set 'Smallest edge after Novig's fee' to 7% or 10% so only the obviously wrong prices qualify, and keep the stake, 'most on one game', 'most in a day' and the day's loss stop small (e.g. 2 / 5 / 20 / 5); (6) Sockets: Novig market feed ON, BoltOdds ON (second opinion on a decided game), Pinnodds and the 'Only with a Pinnodds socket' pages not needed. Leave 'Include live games' (in the +EV feed) OFF if you only want Live light. The 'What it is doing' box shows the games it watches and why each bet was or wasn't made.
